title: Optimizing RAG Rerankers with LLM Feedback via Reinforcement Learning
authors: Yuhang Wu; Xiangqing Shen; Fanfan Wang; Cangqi Zhou; Zhen Wu; Xinyu Dai; Rui Xia
why_relevant: Optimizes rerankers using LLM feedback to improve context utility for RAG; tangentially related to filtering noisy retrieval but focused on performance, not robustness.
